title: 인천광역시 남구와 남동구, 동구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 인천광역시 남구와 남동구, 동구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 1 (Change of Jurisdictional Areas between Nam-gu and Namdong-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City) Lot Nos. 940-1, 941, 942-1, 1362-1, 1363-2, 1379-10, 1598-8, and 1598-9 in Juan-dong, Nam-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City shall be excluded from the jurisdictional area of Nam-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City, and incorporated into the jurisdictional area of Namdong-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City.
